name: implement a flask http post endpoint returning structured classification results
definition: Expose a JSON endpoint that accepts a text field and returns a sentiment label and a per-class confidence object.
failure_mode: wrong schema or flipped confidence ordering fails request assertions

name: implement a game-playing function exposing a required exact interface in pure JavaScript
definition: Write a plain JS function (not a class) that provides a per-turn decision method receiving a cell-state object and returning an allowed action string, with no external imports.
failure_mode: Wrong function signature/pattern or use of an imported library causes load or regex failures.
